failure_modes.cause: BPR set to 1.5 bar is insufficient to suppress vapor pressure of solvent at 60°C (P_vap ~0.8-1.0 bar) plus pressure drop, leading to two-phase flow and residence time distribution broadening
failure_modes.mitigation: Increase BPR setting to minimum 2.5 bar (P_vap + dP + 0.5 bar margin) and install pressure relief valve at 3.0 bar

failure_modes.mode: Incomplete quenching leading to runaway or product degradation
failure_modes.cause: Single-stage EAS with quench requirement; if quench stream fails or mixing is insufficient at low Re (23), exothermic side reactions or product decomposition may occur downstream
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement redundant quench injection point and install inline IR sensor to monitor reaction completion before quench zone

failure_modes.mode: Clogging of narrow-bore reactor (0.75 mm ID)
failure_modes.cause: Electrophilic aromatic substitution may produce polymeric byproducts or precipitates; low Reynolds number (23) reduces shear forces that might otherwise keep particles suspended
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter (50 µm) before reactor and implement periodic backflush protocol; monitor pressure drop for sudden increases

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — failure to maintain pressure causes boiling
Quench pump — failure leads to unquenched reactive mixture
Inline heater — failure causes temperature drop and incomplete conversion
validation_experiments: Run solvent-only at 60°C with BPR set to 1.5 bar; monitor for pressure oscillations or flow rate instability indicating flashing
Perform quench failure simulation: stop quench stream for 2 minutes while monitoring downstream temperature and product selectivity
Run extended stability test (4 hours) with simulated feed containing 1% potential precipitate; monitor pressure drop trend for clogging indicators
